steps: Open each PDF from the file picker, including the large and malformed cases.
expected: Valid PDFs open and display a page.
The malformed PDF produces a clear actionable error without crashing or altering the file.

steps: Open both PDFs, switch between their tabs, then close each tab.
expected: Each tab shows the correct document and current page state.
Closing one tab leaves the other document open.

steps: Open the document and browse thumbnails; select a distant page in the large file.
expected: Thumbnail selection navigates to the matching page.
The large document remains navigable without rendering every page at full resolution at open.

steps: Open the document, expand its bookmarks, and activate a bookmark.
expected: Supported bookmarks and hierarchy are shown.
Activating a bookmark navigates to its destination.

steps: Search for known text in digital pages and in the scanned page, then move through matches.
expected: Digital text matches are highlighted and navigable.
Scanned text is reported as not searchable when OCR is unavailable; no false match is presented.

steps: Select known text and copy it into a plain-text destination.
expected: Selected text can be copied.
Extracted characters follow available Unicode mappings, with missing mappings handled clearly.

steps: Zoom in and out, then use fit-width and fit-page on representative pages.
expected: The page redraws at the requested scale and remains legible.
Repeated zoom changes do not leave stale overlays or unbounded page render accumulation.

steps: View pages with nonzero rotation and rotate a page clockwise and counterclockwise.
expected: Content, selection, and overlays align with the displayed orientation.
Rotation persists after save and reopen when it is a document edit.

steps: Navigate by next/previous, page number, and selected thumbnail, including first and last pages.
expected: The requested page is displayed and the page indicator is correct.
Out-of-range page input is rejected clearly.

steps: Open print preview and print selected pages to a PDF printer; inspect page size, orientation, and appearance.
expected: Printed pages preserve intended appearance and page selection.
Any raster fallback is explicitly identified.
A signed source is not silently represented as an unchanged valid signature after editing.

steps: Select and replace existing text with a longer string and with characters unavailable in the source subset font; save as a new PDF and reopen in an independent viewer.
expected: Actual text content is replaced and persists after reopen.
Original text is absent at the edited location, replacement glyphs are represented or a clear supported limitation is shown, and neighboring content remains intact.

steps: Select existing image placements, edit one occurrence of a shared image, save, close, reopen, and inspect.
expected: The selected image changes persist.
Unselected occurrences and unrelated page content remain unchanged.

steps: Add text at a chosen page position, save, close, reopen, and inspect in an independent viewer.
expected: Added text appears at the chosen location and persists as selectable PDF text.
Existing content remains intact.

steps: Insert an image, save as a new PDF, close, reopen, and inspect.
expected: The image is present at the chosen position and size after reopen.
Other page content remains intact.

steps: Move a supported text or image object to a known location, save, and reopen.
expected: The selected object moves to the expected page coordinates after reopen.
Unrelated objects retain their positions.

steps: Resize a supported image placement while preserving aspect ratio, save, and reopen.
expected: The selected placement has the expected dimensions after reopen.
The image content is not unintentionally distorted.

steps: Replace a selected image and replace a selected text object; save and reopen.
expected: Each replacement occupies the selected object location and persists.
No unrelated object or shared image occurrence changes unexpectedly.

steps: Delete a selected image and a selected text object, save and reopen.
expected: Deleted objects are absent from rendered output and normal extraction.
Unrelated content remains intact.

steps: Insert a page from the second document at a chosen position, save and reopen.
expected: The inserted page appears at the requested index with its content intact.
Existing pages retain their content and order.

steps: Delete a selected page, save and reopen.
expected: The selected page is absent and remaining pages retain their content and order.
Supported navigation references are updated or clearly identified as unsupported.

steps: Move a uniquely identifiable page to a new position, save and reopen.
expected: The page order matches the requested sequence and each page retains its content.

steps: Rotate one selected page, save and reopen in an independent viewer.
expected: Only the selected page has the requested orientation after reopen.
Content is neither clipped nor shifted unexpectedly.

steps: Extract a selected page range to a new PDF, then reopen both source and extracted files.
expected: The extracted file contains exactly the selected pages in order.
The source remains unchanged.

steps: Merge the second document into the first at a chosen insertion point; save and reopen.
expected: All expected pages appear in the requested order with page content preserved.

steps: Highlight a text range, save, close, reopen, and select the annotation.
expected: Highlight geometry follows the selected text and remains editable after reopen.

steps: Underline a text range, save, and reopen in an independent viewer.
expected: Underline geometry follows the selected text and remains editable after reopen.

steps: Strike out a text range, save, and reopen in an independent viewer.
expected: Strikeout geometry follows the selected text and remains editable after reopen.

steps: Draw an ink stroke with multiple points, modify it, save, and reopen.
expected: The stroke and its modified geometry persist and remain selectable/editable.

steps: Draw and modify a line annotation, save, and reopen.
expected: The line endpoints and appearance persist and the annotation remains editable.

steps: Draw an arrow annotation, change an endpoint, save, and reopen.
expected: The arrow direction, endpoints, and appearance persist and remain editable.

steps: Add and resize a rectangle and ellipse; save and reopen.
expected: Both shapes retain geometry and appearance and remain individually editable.

steps: Add a text box with a comment, change its text and placement, save, and reopen.
expected: The text box text and geometry persist and remain editable.

steps: Add a sticky note with comment text, edit it, save, and reopen in an independent viewer.
expected: The note and comment persist and remain editable/interoperable.

steps: Add and edit comment text on markup and note annotations; save and reopen.
expected: Comment text remains associated with the correct annotation after reopen.

feature: Markup: select, modify, delete, color, opacity, and stroke width
steps: Select each supported annotation class, change its geometry and available style properties, then delete one annotation; save and reopen.
expected: Supported geometry, color, opacity, and stroke width changes persist.
Deleted markup is absent.
Other annotations remain intact and editable.

steps: Save a page containing each supported markup type and open it in an independent PDF viewer.
expected: The independent viewer displays the annotations with their saved appearance and comment data.

steps: Perform text/image, markup, and page operations; undo and redo each, then save and reopen.
expected: Undo restores the preceding document state and redo reapplies it.
Saved output matches the final visible state.

feature: Reliability: safe saving and source preservation
steps: Save edits as a new file; separately try a locked destination, a failed write, and editing a signed source copy.
expected: The original remains valid if writing, validation, or replacement fails.
A candidate is reopened and structurally checked before replacing a destination.
Signature consequences are explained and an old signature is not shown as valid on modified content.

steps: Make and undo a change, then make a new change; close each state with and without saving.
expected: The dirty indicator follows unsaved document changes.
Closing a dirty document prompts for save/discard/cancel and honors the choice.

steps: Edit a document, allow a recovery snapshot, terminate the worker/application abnormally, and relaunch.
expected: The original file remains intact.
The app offers recovery of the latest valid work and identifies the recovered state.

steps: Open malformed input, provide an incorrect password, and attempt a save to a locked destination.
expected: Each failure produces a clear actionable message, leaves the app responsive, and preserves source data.

feature: Reliability: installer on a clean Windows 11 x64 machine
steps: Install the per-user build in a clean Windows 11 x64 VM without developer tools or a paid PDF program; open, edit, annotate, reorder, undo/redo, save, close, reopen, and print.
expected: Installation and the P0 workflow complete without development tools or network access.
Saved output passes the same independent-viewer checks as the harness.

feature: Reliability: portable build, repair/reinstall, upgrade, and uninstall
steps: Run the portable build, upgrade/reinstall the installed build, repair it, then uninstall from the clean Windows VM.
expected: Portable and installed builds launch and open PDFs.
Repair/reinstall and upgrade retain user documents and recovery data.
Uninstall removes app files without deleting user PDFs.
